name: FoxLpBondsPool pre-swap spot pricing over-mints FOX
summary: stake() prices the entire USDT bond from the FOX/USDT pair before swapping half of that same deposit through the shallow pair. It then mints FOX-denominated bond and referral inventory from the stale pre-swap quote. One financed call minted endogenous FOX and sold it back into the pair, depleting its liquid USDT reserve.
notes: Reset is FOX.setTreasury pointing FOX's mint right at the Treasury proxy (before: an EOA), the last mint grant stake() needs; Treasury.setStakingPool(pool) and the sFOX/rFOX setTreasury calls came earlier. Later FOX changes (sell-tax pool, transfer switch) only size or gate trading.

Loss is the FOX/USDT pair's USDT depletion; the FOX it received was minted in the same call. The flash lenders' fee gains are outside the victim. The attacker's referral binding (0x5b973f71) is setup, and its follow-up stake attempts all reverted, so the campaign is empty.
